title: malva tournefortiana var. lusitanica
intro: Malva tournefortiana var. lusitanica, commonly known as the Lusitanian mallow, is a plant species in the family Malvaceae. It is known for its medicinal properties, where it has been used to treat various health conditions, including digestive issues and skin problems. The plant has been reported to possess several health benefits, such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, which may be attributed to its therapeutic actions, including anti-diarrheal, anti-ulcerogenic, and wound-healing properties. The bioactive constituents of the Lusitanian mallow include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and mucilages, which are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
